title: $:/plugins/xyvir/anchors-for-streams
author: xyvir
description: Allows for 'anchoring' top-level streams nodes; so you can clone the whole stream and use the anchors to spawn stream independent sibling nodes.
name: Anchors for streams

The $select widget has no style attribute support (TW core wires only class/size/multiple/disabled/tabindex/title), so an inline style on it is silently dropped and the control falls back to the browser default chrome -- a light UA widget on a dark palette. Its chrome therefore lives here. Vars, not <>, so a live palette switch re-themes it. */ .lithic-anchor-tpl-select { min-width: 250px; background: var(--lithic-c-page); color: var(--lithic-c-foreground); border: 1px solid var(--lithic-c-line); padding: 4px; } "}}}
